findings.summary: Trust-anchor self-certification: signer keys/roles come from a trust configuration bound by the plan's own canonicalContractSHA256, and verifier contracts are selected from the set the plan pins; a plan author could pin a contract set that registers its own root-plan key or weaker verifiers
findings.requiredRevision: pin the root-plan/root-fence/root-seal/cp-inventory/host-helper anchors and the reviewed verifier contract set outside the plan being authenticated (reviewed helper build or registered worker-root/trust registration) and state that the plan only selects within that pinned set

findings.summary: Proof slots are untyped at schema and specification level: 56 proof refs share one shape with no normative slot->contractSHA256/signer-role/scope-derivation table; swapping independentPlanReview and rootPublicationIntent stays schema-valid with an unchanged planSubject, and the fixture approval scopes are not the subject digest while their typed derivation is unspecified; reserve rootExecutionDecision scope to the final envelope is likewise prose-only
findings.requiredRevision: add a closed per-slot proof registry (field path -> contract, signer role, typed scope recipe, freshness) inside the pinned contract set, plus red fixtures for slot swaps and cross-kind reuse

findings.summary: Post-seal failure is not representable: migration-journal forces terminalSealEnvelopeSHA256 null and a held lease for BLOCKED_FORWARD_ONLY/QUIESCENCE_UNKNOWN, so a failed or unknown restart-policy restore after SEALED can only be journaled by dropping the seal reference (verified: keep seal -> invalid, drop seal + lease -> valid)
findings.requiredRevision: allow blocked phases to retain the existing seal (required when a SEALED event exists) with lease rules per operation, and add red/green fixtures

findings.summary: Integral floats 1.0/1e0 and -0 pass every integer field at the schema layer (60/60); strict-byte fixtures cover only 1.5
findings.requiredRevision: add strict-byte rejects for 1.0, 1e0, 1E2, -0 and require Go and Python readers to agree before schema evaluation

findings.summary: timestamp relies on format date-time, which Draft 2020-12 treats as an annotation; 2026-02-30T25:61:61Z is schema-valid without a format checker
findings.requiredRevision: mandate strict RFC3339 parsing and add a red fixture

findings.summary: OLD_FENCED covers both restart=no applied while still running and stopped/quiescent (stopOld is OLD_FENCED->OLD_FENCED); captureFenced eligibility depends on the stop outcome receipt, stated only in prose
findings.requiredRevision: make the stop-outcome predecessor normative in state-machine.json or split the phase

findings.summary: migration-event inventoryEnvelopeSHA256/terminalSealEnvelopeSHA256 are not phase-gated (schema-valid on BOOTSTRAP_VERIFIED_RESTART_NO) and effect.kind is not bound to phase in the schema (S08 prose)
findings.requiredRevision: add phase-conditional nullability and method/phase/effect table

findings.summary: The VALID terminal-seal and inventory fixtures put backup and current on different daemon identities (and the seal reuses one name for both), violating S05; the harness checks S05 restart only, as stated
findings.requiredRevision: make positive fixtures semantically coherent or label them structure-only

findings.summary: Acquisition/release order between host OS locks and the logical fence CAS and nested re-entrancy is not specified beyond PC2-then-PC4 and per-call matching
envelopeSHA256 covers signature bytes; specify RFC 8032 strict verification; a malleated duplicate fails closed through no-overwrite
failureExits allows a same-phase failure event while the spec limits same-phase events to intent or readback; reconcile wording
